jqara.scope: official per-query candidate pools; not whole-Wikipedia retrieval

scifact.scope: full 5183-document corpus; unjudged treated as nonrelevant

python_docs.scope: six real official tutorial pages; authored questions and silver section labels

limitations: JQaRA retrieves within official query-specific pools, not whole Wikipedia.
SciFact unjudged documents are treated as nonrelevant according to standard qrels evaluation.
Python labels identify an authored target section, not exhaustive independently reviewed chunk relevance.
All timings are observed client wall time, not isolated model inference. Jev batches 25 decisions per request; Luna uses independent pointwise calls with concurrency eight.
One model run, sampled queries, no claim of universal model superiority; bootstrap intervals condition on this sample.
study: Jev Score and Noul RAG reranking, 2026-10-29

parser_recovery.cause: Responses API includes error:null on successful requests. Fixed client null handling.
parser_recovery.timing_policy: Exclude any query using cached calls from wall-time distributions.
parser_recovery.final_answer_extraction: A later response contained commentary and a final_answer message. Only the final_answer JSON is evaluated. Cached response reused without resubmission.
